title: Umuskuti ufite amababa
intro: Mu bwami bwayobowe n'umuntu wahawe ububasha ku miyaga, ku biremwa bitagaragara, no ku biremwa byo mu kirere, umuntu umwe muto kandi wihuta yazimiye mu ntera - hanyuma agaruka afite ibyahishuwe byari guhindura iherezo ry'igihugu cya kure. Uyu mutangabuhamya w'amatwi yazanye ukuri aho ubujiji bwari bwarashinze imizi. Ndi nde?
clues: Nakoreye mu rukiko aho abantu, ibiremwa bitagaragara, n'ibiremwa byo mu kirere byasubizaga umutegetsi umwe w'umunyabwenge wategekaga umuyaga.
Namaze igihe ntari ku mwanya wanjye, kandi uburakari bw'umutegetsi bwaransezeranyijwe nintatanga impamvu ifatika.
Ndi ikiremwa gito gikunda kuguruka, kizwiho kubona neza, kandi ubwoko bwanjye bwahawe icyubahiro cyo guhabwa amazina mu buryo butaziguye mu mapaji yahishuwe.
Ubwo nagarukaga, nazanye inkuru y'igihugu cya kure aho abantu bapfukamiye izuba, batabona Uwaremye ijuru n'isi.
Nasanze umugore utegeka ubwami bukomeye, yicaye ku ntebe y'ubwami ihebuje, atari yarigeze amenya ukuri mbere.
Ni njye wavumbuye ubwami bwa Saba' kandi nitwaje ibaruwa y'ubutumire bw'umuhanuzi-umwami wahawe ububasha ku muyaga.
